fn get_type_ident_fallback(t: &Type) -> String { 
    match t {
        Type::Int => "int".to_string(),
        Type::Byte => "byte".to_string(),
        Type::Bool => "bool".to_string(),
        Type::Arena => "Arena".to_string(),
        Type::Void => "void".to_string(),
        Type::Str => "str".to_string(),
        Type::RawPointer(inner) => format!("{}_ptr", get_type_ident_fallback(inner)),
        Type::Slice(inner) => format!("Slice_{}", get_type_ident_fallback(inner)),
        Type::Struct(name, _) => name.clone(),
        Type::Index(name, _) => format!("Index_{}", name),
        _ => "unknown".to_string(),
    }
}

fn erase_type_with_registry(t: &Type, registry: &HashMap<String, StructLayout>) -> Type {
    match t {
        Type::Struct(name, brand) => {
            let erased_name = erase_struct_name_with_registry(name, brand, registry);
            Type::Struct(erased_name, None)
        }
        Type::Index(struct_name, brand) => {
            let erased_struct = erase_struct_name_with_registry(struct_name, brand, registry);
            Type::Index(erased_struct, None)
        }
        Type::RawPointer(inner) => {
            Type::RawPointer(Box::new(erase_type_with_registry(inner, registry)))
        }
        Type::Slice(inner) => Type::Slice(Box::new(erase_type_with_registry(inner, registry))),
        Type::Generic(name, args) => {
            let arg_names: Vec<String> = args
                .iter()
                .map(|arg| {
                    let erased_arg = erase_type_with_registry(arg, registry);
                    match erased_arg {
                        Type::Int => "int".to_string(),
                        Type::Byte => "byte".to_string(),
                        Type::Bool => "bool".to_string(),
                        Type::Arena => "Arena".to_string(),
                        Type::Void => "void".to_string(),
                        Type::Str => "str".to_string(),
                        Type::RawPointer(inner) => {
                            format!("{}_ptr", get_type_ident_fallback(&inner))
                        }
                        Type::Slice(inner) => {
                            format!("Slice_{}", get_type_ident_fallback(&inner))
                        }
                        Type::Struct(s_name, _) => s_name,
                        Type::Index(s_name, _) => format!("Index_{}", s_name),
                        Type::Generic(g_name, g_args) => {
                            let g_erased = erase_type_with_registry(&Type::Generic(g_name, g_args), registry);
                            match g_erased {
                                Type::Struct(s_name, _) => s_name,
                                _ => "unknown".to_string(),
                            }
                        }
                        _ => "unknown".to_string(),
                    }
                })
                .collect();
            let mono_name = format!("{}_{}", name, arg_names.join("_")).replace(".", "_");
            let erased_name = erase_struct_name_with_registry(&mono_name, &None, registry);
            Type::Struct(erased_name, None)
        }
        _ => t.clone(),
    }
}
